text: What is the white car allowed to do at this place?
explanation: LESSON 26If the carriageway is divided into lanes by a broken white line, you are only allowed to stop on the carriageway.

text: You are involved in an accident. May the police ask you to take a saliva test?

options.text: Only if there is a strong suspicion of drug use.
Yes, in the event of an accident, always.

explanation: LESSON 28Normally, a saliva test may only be carried out if the police suspect drug use.BUT NOTE: if you are involved in an accident, the police may always require a saliva test.If the result is above the permitted limit:- your driving licence must be immediately surrendered for 12 hours;- an immediate withdrawal of the driving licence is also possible;- after the 12 hours, a new saliva test is carried out.Offenders also risk heavy fines and a driving ban of up to 5 years.

text: The brown car is parked. The blue car …

options.text: ... passes the brown car on the left.
... overtakes the brown car on the left.

explanation: LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: When you see this traffic sign, you know ...

options.text: ... that the tunnel is 200 meters long.
... that the tunnel is 500 meters long.

explanation: LESSON 29The upper sign indicates that the tunnel is at least 500 meters long.The exact length can be shown on the upper sign.The additional sign indicates that the tunnel starts in 200 meters.

text: In areas where the speed limit is 30 km/h, pedestrians always have priority when crossing the road.
explanation: LESSON 7A pedestrian who wants to cross the road at a place where there is no pedestrian crossing must give way themselves.Nevertheless, drivers must always be cautious.

text: At what distance (... meters) behind the broken down vehicle do you place a warning triangle on the hard shoulder on the motorway?
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: Beyond which sign you cannot overtake a cyclist on the left?
explanation: It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: There is snow on the roadway. The rear fog light should be on.
explanation: LESSON 11 - 'Lights'

text: The train has already passed. Are you allowed to drive on while the barriers are still rising?
explanation: LESSON 18You may only cross the level crossing when the barriers are fully raised and the white moonlight signal is on.

text: This parking prohibition applies to the carriageway and the verge and ends after the first intersection.
explanation: LESSON 26A zonal traffic sign does not end at the first intersection.It remains in force until the “End of zone” sign is displayed.

text: An intersection without traffic signs between a paved road and a dirt road. Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 20At an intersection between a paved road and a dirt road, the priority-to-the-right rule does not apply.

text: Must you use the left indicator when you're already properly positioned to turn left?

options.text: Yes, always, and turn it off as soon as the manoeuvre is completed.
No, because you're already well positioned.

explanation: LESSON 21A turn signal is there to indicate your intentions, even if you are already in the right position.

text: How old must you be to take the theoretical exam for a category B driving licence?
explanation: DRIVING LICENCEAs soon as you are 17 years old, you may take the theory exam in an official exam centre. To pass, you need to score at least 41 out of 50 points.

text: What does this blue information sign mean?
explanation: LESSON 5 – ‘The express road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Semi-monthly alternating parking. What do you have to take into account?

options.text: With the date and with the house numbers.

text: After drinking a lot of alcohol, what actually lowers your blood alcohol level?

options.text: Taking medication prescribed by my pharmacist.
Waiting, only time reduces your blood alcohol level.

explanation: LESSON 28There are no medicines or tricks to lower your blood alcohol level. The only solution is to wait until your body has processed the alcohol and you are sober again.

text: Does the priority to the right also apply in a supermarket car park?
explanation: LESSON 20The priority to the right also generally applies in a supermarket car park, as it is usually considered a place accessible to public traffic.Therefore, the normal road traffic rules apply.ImportantLeaving a parking space (forwards or backwards) is a special manoeuvre: the driver must give way to all other traffic.If there are road signs, yield markings, stop signs or arrows on the ground, these priority rules must be followed.

text: The white car is approaching an intersection and wants to turn left. At the intersection, a police officer is standing with one arm stretched out horizontally. What must the driver do?

options.text: The driver may go straight ahead or turn right.

explanation: LESSON 17When a police officer holds one or both arms stretched out horizontally, road users approaching the officer’s front or back must stop.Road users approaching from the sides or towards the fingertips may enter the intersection and go straight, turn left or turn right.A police officer with two arms stretched out horizontally gives exactly the same instruction as with one arm stretched out.

text: The marks in the grooves indicate when the minimum tread depth is reached. It is then time to change the tyre.
explanation: Explanation: See lesson 31

text: *** 5 points question *** There are no cyclists on and near the crossing. Is the blue car allowed to overtake the brown one on the left?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The white car has overtaken the blue car on the left. Must the driver use the indicator when moving back to the right lane?
explanation: LESSON 16For every lateral movement, the indicator must be switched on.During the overtaking itself, it remains switched off.

text: A driver exits a paid parking area. The policeman wants to take a breath test, but the driver refuses his corporation. The policeman will give him a temporary driving ban of (... ) hours.
explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 28

text: Who is the first to cross the intersection?
explanation: LESSON 19 – ‘Junction and traffic sign’. The car must give priority to MANAGERS on the intersection.A pedestrian is not a driver, but there is a crossroads for pedestrians.Therefore the pedestrian is allowed to go first.

text: The traffic light is red. Can you read messages on your cell phone while you wait?
What must a tram driver take into account? 1. The orders of an authorized person. 2. The traffic lights. 3. The priority rules.
explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: A driver has to make a long trip abroad. How often should he ideally take a break?
explanation: During a long car journey, it is recommended to take a short break of at least 15 minutes about every two hours to prevent fatigue and stay alert. Make sure to get out of the car, stretch your legs, take deep breaths, and stay hydrated with water or light snacks.

text: You are not allowed to drive past this sign with a car. But are you allowed to come out of this street with your car?
explanation: LESSON 23 – ‘Prohibited direction’.This prohibitive sign indicates no entry past this sign to drivers of all vehicles having more than two wheels or motorcycles with a side car.

text: You change direction and see this traffic sign. Do you then have to give way to cyclists, riders of two-wheeled mopeds, and pedestrians who are using the same public road?
explanation: LESSONThis sign (F50bis) warns drivers who change direction that cyclists, riders of two-wheeled mopeds, and pedestrians are using the same public road.When changing direction, the driver must give way to these road users.Sometimes only the cyclist symbol or only a pedestrian crossing symbol is shown; the meaning remains the same.

text: Who has priority at this intersection?
explanation: LESSON 19It is an intersection where you must give way to drivers coming from the right.

text: You forget to pull up the hand brake after parking during the practical examination/test.

options.text: The examiner doesn’t pay attention to that.
You have to do the examination again.

explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 27

text: Beyond the sign, I may drive at a maximum speed of 20 km/h in the Walloon Region.
explanation: LESSON 6The sign indicates the beginning of a residential zone.The maximum permitted speed there is 20 km/h.

text: A roadway that is not divided into lanes. Is the blue car parked correctly?
explanation: LESSON 25The blue information sign indicates a one-way street.The blue car is parked facing against the direction of traffic.In a one-way street, you must park in the direction of traffic.

text: You parked your car in a street and spent the night at your grandparents’ house. The next morning you want to leave, but the street has become a school street. Are you allowed to drive away?

options.text: Yes, but only at walking speed.

explanation: LESSON 6To reduce traffic congestion at the start and end of the school day, a street near a school may be closed twice a day to motor vehicles. When this happens, the street becomes a school street. This is indicated by a C3 (no entry) traffic sign, together with an additional panel stating SCHOOL STREET.Who may enter a school street?– Pedestrians, cyclists, and speed pedelecs.– Residents of the street or drivers who have a garage there (with a permit).– Priority vehicles.– Vehicles with a special permit.

text: The windshield washer reservoir is empty. This may negatively affect the driver’s visibility. What should you do?
explanation: LESSON 31If you hear a humming or buzzing sound when you activate the washer but no liquid sprays onto the windshield, the reservoir is empty. You should refill it as soon as possible, because without washer fluid your visibility can be greatly reduced, especially in rain or when dirt splashes up from the road. Just like engine oil, the washer fluid level should be checked regularly.

text: You are not allowed to park or to be stationary on the road within (…) meters in front of a crossing for cyclists or two-wheeled mopeds.
explanation: LESSON 25 – ‘Waiting and parking’.You are not allowed to be stationary or park on the road within 5 meters of a crossing for pedestrians or cyclists.

text: Is this car allowed to park at that spot in this residential area?

options.text: No, it must park on the shoulder.
Yes, because in a residential area, you are allowed to park on the left or right side of the roadway.

explanation: In a residential area, cars may only park in places specifically designated for parking. They may be parked on either the left or right side of the roadway, depending on the direction of traffic.

text: You are approaching an intersection where an officer is standing with one arm extended horizontally. What instruction is the officer giving?

options.text: You may continue driving, but not turn right.

explanation: LESSON 17When an officer extends one or both arms horizontally, road users approaching the officer’s chest or back must stop.Road users approaching the officer’s fingertips or side may continue onto the intersection to go straight, turn left, or turn right.An officer with both arms extended horizontally gives exactly the same instruction as with only one arm extended horizontally.

text: The driver of this car is waiting for her friend within a built-up area. Is the car parked correctly?

options.text: Yes, because the car is in front of the traffic sign.

explanation: LESSON 26In that place, this car is allowed to park or stand still on the roadway.

text: When the M.A.W. of the trailer exceeds 750 kg, a driving license B is ok, provided that the M.A.W. of the car and the trailer together does not exceed (…) ton.
explanation: LESSON 10 – ‘The load and the passenger spaces’.With a provisional driving license B you cannot pull a trailer.

text: At this junction the right of way applies.
explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’. It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: To overtake a vehicle which is overtaking another vehicle is called …
explanation: LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You’re without gas and your garage is at the beginning of the street on the right. Are you allowed to push your car to the right?

options.text: No, because you are still a driver.
Yes, because then you are a pedestrian.

explanation: LESSON 23 – ‘Prohibited direction’.If you push your car, you are still a driver.This sign indicates that turning to the right lane is prohibited at the next junction to all drivers.

text: There is a queue because of an accident on the right lane. Who gets priority to drive on on the middle lane?
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: How much lateral distance should the car driver leave when he passes the cyclist.
explanation: It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You want to leave the motorway. Where should you brake?

options.text: Only once you are on the exit lane.

explanation: LESSON 4Of course, there is no rule that obliges you to still drive 120 km/h just before the exit. You may already drive a bit slower before reaching the exit. But actual braking, meaning pressing the brake pedal, should only be done once you are on the exit lane.

text: *** 5 points question *** The barriers are still fully open, but the alarm signal is clearly audible. Can you still drive on the road?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’. No. That would be a serious offense !!!

text: Does this traffic sign also apply to buses and coaches?
explanation: This sign means: No entry for drivers of motor vehicles and trailers designed and built for the transport of goods.An additional sign underneath may limit this prohibition to vehicles or combinations whose maximum authorised mass exceeds the indicated value.

text: Is driving at too high an engine speed also harmful to the environment?
explanation: LESSON 30When you let your engine run unnecessarily at high revs, it consumes more fuel and emits more CO₂ and nitrogen oxides. This is harmful to the environment and increases engine wear, leading to higher maintenance costs.

text: You approach this junction with your car.

options.text: You are allowed to turn right.
You are allowed to cross the junction.

explanation: LESSON 23 – ‘Prohibited direction’.This prohibitive sign indicates no entry to any driver (including cyclists) to drive past this sign in this direction.

text: You are approaching an intersection where a police officer is standing with one arm raised. What do you do?

options.text: You slow down and wait for the order he will give.

explanation: LESSON 17When a police officer raises one arm vertically at an intersection, all road users must stop.Anyone already on the intersection must leave it as quickly as possible.

text: *** 5 points question *** Who has priority?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 14 – ‘Crossing’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: *** 5 points question *** Is it allowed to overtake a moped on the left beyond this sign?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 16The red sign says that drivers are forbidden to overtake a vehicle with more than two wheels on the left.

text: Are you allowed to stop on these road markings on your left to let someone out of the car?
explanation: LESSON 2 – ‘The lanes’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: This sign says there are traffic lights (150 meters further). This plate is ...
explanation: LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’. This danger or warning sign means traffic lights. Danger signs are placed 150 meters before a danger.

text: This combination of signs indicate a slippery road within a distance of 7.5km because of ice or snow.
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Parking meter / Parking disk. How long can you park (unless stated otherwise)?
explanation: LESSON 27

text: *** 5 points question *** Are you allowed to drive past this sign with a car?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 23 – ‘Prohibited direction’.This prohibitive sign indicates no entry to any driver, with the exception of cyclists, pedelecs and mopeds class A to drive past this sign in this direction.

text: The farmer walking next to his cows is …
explanation: LESSON 8 – ‘The drivers’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: N -roads are …
explanation: LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: *** 5 points question *** Can you send a text while waiting in the car for a red light?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’. That is prohibited.

text: The train is gone and the barriers are going up. If you leave now with your car …

options.text: ... it is not a real offence.
... your driving licence can be suspended immediately.

explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: A doctor decides that you are medically unfit to drive a vehicle. Within how many days must you hand in your driving licence at the municipality?
explanation: LESSON – Introduction driving licence BIf a doctor decides that you are physically or mentally unfit to drive, you must inform the municipality and surrender your driving licence within 4 days after receiving this decision.Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays are not included.

text: Which of these signs relate to the Maximum Authorized Weight M.A.W. of a car?
explanation: LESSON 9 – ‘M.A.W. and M.G.W.’.Signs 1 relate to the M.G.W.Signs 2 , 3 (okt 2022) , 4 : M.A.W.

text: Does the certificate of conformity that you show to the police have to be the original document?

options.text: The original document or a colour copy.

explanation: LESSON 9All documents that must be carried in the vehicle have to be original.The only exception is the insurance certificate: this document may also be shown digitally, for example as an image on your smartphone.

text: Are these two vehicles crossing each other in the correct way?
explanation: LESSON 14Vehicles must cross each other on the right. Only if arrows on the roadway indicate that they must cross on the left, is this of course allowed.

text: What is the tool called that prevents you from slipping when you suddenly have to change direction?
explanation: Explanation: See lesson 31

text: You are not allowed to drive past these signs with a car, of course. But are you allowed to come out of the street with a car?
explanation: LESSON 23 – ‘Prohibited direction’.This sign means: no entry in both directions to any driver, except cyclists and pedelecs.

text: This warning sign indicates a pedestrian crossing. Where is this sign placed in Flanders?
explanation: LESSON 7In Flanders, warning signs are generally placed 150 metres before the hazard.This allows the driver to be warned in time, so they can reduce speed and pay extra attention.In practice, this distance may be adjusted (for example in built-up areas or when visibility is limited), but the general rule remains: 150 metres in advance.

text: The white car is in the middle of the intersection and the police officer raises one arm. What must the driver do?
explanation: LESSON 17When a police officer raises one arm at an intersection, all road users must stop.Drivers who are already on the intersection must leave it as quickly as possible.

text: What does the 55 on this tyre mean?

options.text: The width of the tyre in mm.
The diameter of the rim in inches.

explanation: Explanation: See lesson 31

text: You approach a bend. When do you brake?

options.text: You brake well enough before the bend.

explanation: Explanation: See lesson 31

text: *** 5 points question *** The blue car is slowing down. Is the grey car allowed to overtake on the left?

options.text: Yes, if there is no pedestrian.

explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The light of ABS keeps burning while driving, this indicates a malfunction. How do you react?

options.text: You immediately stop and call the roadside assistance.
You can keep on driving without any problems.

explanation: Explanation: See lesson 31

text: It is 4:05 pm when the car stops. The driver asks the passenger to set the parking disc. Where must the arrow be set?
explanation: LESSON 27On the parking disc, you set the arrow to the first marking after the time of arrival.You may then park for two hours, counted from the time shown by the arrow,unless a road sign indicates a different parking duration.Afterwards, you must move the car; you are not allowed to change the time on the disc.➡️ The first marking after 4:05 pm is 4:30 pm.

text: There is heavy fog. Should the front fog lights burn?
explanation: LESSON 11- 'The lights’The front fog lamps are not required on a car.You are therefore never required to make them burn.

text: You drive on a road with this traffic sign on it. Are you allowed to overtake a car on the left at the next junction, when it is safe?
explanation: LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Is it allowed to give a warning signal with the horn of your car when you want to overtake another driver?

options.text: Yes, during the day outside built-up areas.
Yes, during the day in built-up areas.

explanation: LESSON 11- 'The lights’Horn during the day:. Inside and outside built-up areas: to warn others and thus to avoid an accident.. Outside built-up areas: to warn a driver that you want to catch up.

text: May the truck overtake a horse rider on the left?
explanation: LESSON 16This prohibition sign indicates that trucks or combinations with a maximum authorised mass exceeding 3500 kg may not overtake:- a combination of vehicles, or- any vehicle with more than two wheels.The no-overtaking rule applies:- up to and including the next intersection, or- ends earlier if you see the “end of overtaking prohibition” sign.A car driver may therefore overtake a truck on the left after this sign.A bus may also overtake, since it is not a truck.

text: Are you allowed to overtake the motorcycle on the left at this intersection?

options.text: Yes, if you leave sufficient lateral distance.

explanation: LESSON 16At intersections where you have priority, you may overtake other drivers on the left.- Priority at the next intersection.- Priority road.- Green traffic light.

text: Past the flashing amber light …

options.text: ... you are not allowed to drive.
... you are allowed to drive and you have priority.
... you are allowed to drive and you have to apply the normal priority rules.

explanation: LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Is a first aid kit obligatory in the car?
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: You tell the police officer that you have trouble breathing and you refuse a breath test. What is the consequence?

options.text: You are allowed to drive on.
You get a driving ban of 3 hours.
You get a driving ban of 6 hours.

explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 28

text: Are you allowed to drive past this sign with a car?
explanation: LESSON 23 – ‘Prohibited direction’.A regular passenger car has a M.A.W. up to 3.5 tons.

text: Are mopeds allowed to drive past this sign?

options.text: Mopeds class A and class B.

explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: What is the maximum speed allowed in the Walloon region on this road after passing the yellow sign?
explanation: LESSON 12It is a normal roadway divided into two lanes.In the Walloon Region, the maximum permitted speed is 90 km/h.In the Flemish and Brussels Regions, it is 70 km/h.The yellow sign has nothing to do with speed — it is a priority-road sign indicating that you are driving on a priority road.

text: A car may not park on the roadway within 5 metres before a pedestrian or cyclist crossing. But may a driver stop there to let someone get in?
explanation: LESSON 7It is forbidden to park or stop on a pedestrian crossing, even to let someone get in or out.It is also forbidden to park or stop on the roadway within 5 metres before the crossing (parking on the verge is allowed if possible).The same rule applies to crossings for cyclists and two-wheeled mopeds.After the crossing, parking and stopping are allowed, unless prohibited by traffic signs.

text: Is the driver of the brown car allowed to overtake the blue one on the left?
explanation: LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Enter a number: After which sign do you not expect cars coming from the opposite direction?
explanation: 1. You have priority at the next intersection.2. You have priority at the next intersections.3. One-way street.4. Mandatory direction.

text: May you overtake a cyclist on the left on a raised section of the road inside a built-up area?

options.text: Yes, if you leave 1 metre of safe lateral distance.
Yes, if you leave 1.5 metres of safe lateral distance.

explanation: LESSON 16You may overtake a cyclist or a trotinette on a raised section of the road.

text: You are not allowed to drive past this sign with a car.
explanation: LESSON 5 – ‘The express road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: The round traffic light is green and you want to turn left. But the evacuation arrow is not burning yet. Can you cross the crossroads?
explanation: LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’. A left-hand green arrow placed separately when crossing a crossroads means that the opposite traffic on the lane that leaves the drivers on the left will be held by a red light to facilitate clearing of the intersection.

text: You notice an accident in the other direction of the motorway. What do you do?

options.text: You stop at the first emergency phone.
You stop on the hard shoulder, take your first aid kit and offer assistance.

explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: *** 5 points question *** You drive too fast in a zone 30. How many kph too fast is needed for the POLICE to withhold your driving licence immediately.
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: *** 5 points question *** When does the speed limit apply?

options.text: Only during the school hours and not on holidays.

explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 6 – ‘Special places’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: This picture is taken within a built up area. Is the black car allowed to park on the raised verge?
explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 25

text: Which drivers are not allowed to drive on the cycle lane past this sign?
explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: When the traffic lights are red, cyclists and drivers of two-wheeled mopeds stop in front of …
explanation: LESSON 19 – ‘Junction and traffic sign’. It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Can you overtake a speed pedelec with your car in a bicycle street?
explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.

text: The driver of this car is allowed …
explanation: LESSON 23 – ‘Prohibited direction’.This sign indicates that turning to the left is prohibited at the next junction to all drivers.

text: At a breath test an S appears on the screen..

options.text: You have to do a breath analysis.
You get a temporary driving ban of three hours.

explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 28

text: This picture is taken from the car you drive in. You want to turn right at the junction.

options.text: You are allowed to drive on the bus lane when you intend to change direction at the next junction.
You have to use this lane to change direction.

explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: In a mini bus/van there are maximum (…) seats allowed for passengers.
explanation: LESSON 8 – ‘The drivers’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: This sign means: road works. What kind of sign is it?
explanation: LESSON 2 – ‘The lanes’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: When do you have to increase the tyre pressure a bit?

options.text: You have to drive in the mountains.
There is a lot of snow and ice.
You have a long journey ahead of you.

explanation: LESSON 10 – ‘The load and the passenger spaces’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Is this car allowed to move to the right lane?
explanation: LESSONThe solid white line is on his side. He is not allowed to cross it.After overtaking, however, a car may cross the solid line to return to the right lane.

text: *** 5 points question *** Children until the age of (…), smaller than 1.35m, must be seated in an appropriate safety seat for children.
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 10 – ‘The load and the passenger spaces’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You are driving on a one-way road and you want to turn left. Where should you position yourself correctly?

options.text: On the right side of the roadway.
In the middle of the roadway.
On the left side of the roadway.

explanation: LESSON 21When you want to turn left, you must position yourself as far to the left as possible on the roadway.

text: There is fog and you want to park your car on the road. The rear fog light …

options.text: ... is not allowed to be lit.

explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 25

text: When you carry out a manoeuvre, to whom must you give priority?
explanation: LESSON 21A manoeuvre is an action you perform with your vehicle that is not specifically regulated by the traffic rules (for example, reversing).When you carry out a manoeuvre, you must:- observe very carefully first,- give priority to all road users (both drivers and pedestrians).

text: Are you allowed to drive past this sign to park your car?
