explanation: LESSON 25 – ‘Waiting and parking’.You may only stop there in the event of a breakdown or an accident.

text: The information sign is placed at the pedestrian crossing. Which sign is the information sign?
explanation: LESSON 7 – ‘The pedestrians’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: The ABS warning light stays on. What should you do?

options.text: Remove the fuse so that the warning light goes out.
Continue driving, but go to a garage as soon as possible.
You must stop and are not allowed to continue driving until it is repaired by a mechanic.

explanation: LESSON 31The ABS operates when you press the brake pedal hard and deeply.If the ABS warning light remains on, the ABS system no longer works, but the normal braking system still functions.You may continue driving, but you should go to a garage as soon as possible.

text: There is fog and the visibility is about 150 meters. Which lights must be on?

options.text: Only the dipped headlights and the rear fog light.
The dipped headlights, the rear fog light and the front fog lights.

explanation: LESSON 11When visibility is less than 200 meters, dipped headlights must be on. The rear fog light is only mandatory when visibility is about 100 meters or less.

text: When you drive with a roof rack on top of your car the fuel consumption is only a bit higher. That’s why you don’t have to move it when you don’t need it.
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 30

text: This prohibitive sign applies …
explanation: LESSON 10 – ‘The load and the passenger spaces’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Where must you leave at least 1.5 meters of lateral space when overtaking a cyclist?
explanation: LESSON 15When overtaking outside built-up areas, a driver must leave a lateral distance of at least 1.5 meters between their vehicle and a pedestrian, cyclist, or two-wheeled moped.Inside built-up areas, the required distance is 1 meter.

text: What is the maximum speed limit (… kph) for this car on this motorway?
explanation: LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: In Flanders, the maximum permitted speed on a central lane roadway outside built-up areas is 70 kilometers per hour. How much is that speed in Wallonia?
explanation: In Belgium: 70km/h.

text: What kind of traffic sign is this?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.Almost all rectangular signs with a red border are warning or danger signs (not all of them). Warning signs are placed 150 meter for a danger. Meaning: road narrows on both sides.

text: The green evacuation arrow lights up.

options.text: Everyone can now safely enter the intersection to turn left.
Vehicles at the intersection can evacuate it safely and turn left.

explanation: LESSON 18

text: 25 March. It is snowing heavily. The car is driving with studded tyres on this ordinary road in Flanders.

options.text: The maximum permitted speed is 90 km/h.
The maximum permitted speed is 60 km/h.
He is no longer allowed to drive with studded tyres.

explanation: LESSON 31Studded tyres may only be used between 1 November and 31 March on vehicles with a maximum authorised mass of up to 3.5 tonnes.Maximum permitted speeds:- On ordinary roads: 60 km/h- On motorways and roads with 2x2 lanes: 90 km/hSnow chains may be used when there is snow or ice on the roadway.

text: *** 5 points question *** The traffic lights turn amber. The blue car …

options.text: ... is allowed to drive past the amber lights if it can’t stop safely anymore.

explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What is the maximum speed limit you can drive in a play street?
explanation: LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You have hit a cyclist with your car. What do you do first?
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: How far may this pipe extend beyond the rear of the vehicle?
explanation: LESSON 10A load may extend up to 1 metre beyond the rear of the vehicle.If you must carry a load that is indivisible or cannot be shortened or folded, it may extend up to 3 metres beyond the rear, provided that a warning panel is attached at the end of the load.

text: A cyclist has been hit at an intersection and is lying unconscious on the ground. Are you allowed to clear the intersection and carefully carry the cyclist to the side of the road?

options.text: Yes, you must clear the intersection.
No, an injured person must remain where they are.

explanation: LESSON 29In an accident with injured persons, you leave the injured where they are and call the emergency services.If there are injured persons, the police must also come to make the official report.

text: In a cycle street cars are not allowed to overtake cyclists and speed pedelecs.
explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: What is the maximum permitted speed for the motorcycle on this ordinary road in Wallonia?
explanation: LESSON 2On an ordinary road in Wallonia, the maximum permitted speed is 90 km/h.But there is a traffic sign indicating that the maximum permitted speed is 70 km/h.

text: How many meters is this warning sign placed in front of a crossing for cyclists and two-wheeled mopeds?
explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: A road with 2x2 lanes segregated by a verge. Past these signs the blue car is allowed to drive maximum (…) km/hour.
explanation: LESSON 9 – ‘M.A.W. and M.G.W.’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Do the residents of this road also have to use the parking disc?
explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 27

text: *** 5 points question *** Is car A allowed to turn left?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 2 – ‘The lanes’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: You see this traffic sign. Are you allowed to park a mobile home?
It is nighttime. The car in front of you is driving slowly. Are you allowed to use the horn to signal that you are going to overtake that car?

options.text: Yes, but only outside built-up areas.

explanation: LESSON 11When are you allowed to use the horn?During the day:Inside and outside built-up areas: to warn others and prevent an accident.Outside built-up areas: to warn a driver you want to overtake.Between sunset and sunrise:Only in case of imminent danger.In other situations, instead of the horn, you must use the lights: flashing alternately with high and low beam.

text: It is raining heavily. I switch on the rear fog lights…

options.text: As soon as visibility is less than 100 m.
As soon as visibility is less than 200 m.

explanation: LESSON 11The rear fog light must be switched on when visibility is less than 100 meters in fog or snowfall.In heavy rain, it must always be switched on.

text: Driving with open windows consumes less fuel than with closed windows.
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 30

text: *** 5 points question *** Is a motorcycle allowed to overtake a car on the left past this sign?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The police ask for your driving licence during a check.

options.text: You must always carry the original driving licence with you.
You have 24 hours to present the original driving licence.

explanation: LESSON 9If you are driving, you must have your original driver's license with you.

text: Is the yellow marked part a part of the public road?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Who has to fill in the European/International Accident Form?
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: What is the maximum permitted speed within a built-up area in Flanders?
explanation: LESSON 6In Flanders and Wallonia: maximum 50 km/h.In the Brussels Capital Region: maximum 30 km/h.

text: Friday afternoon. You have passed the theory exam. The town hall is already closed to get a driving licence. Are you allowed to drive a car already?
explanation: LESSON 1The certificate showing that you passed is not a valid provisional driving licence. With it, you are definitely not allowed to drive.

text: What is the name of the part of the public road marked yellow?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: In Flanders. The cars in this picture are allowed to drive maximum (…) kph.
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What is the maximum speed limit (… kph) for this car?
explanation: LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Both cars are driving at 70 km/h. What is the safe following distance?
explanation: LESSON 13You can calculate this distance using a simple formula: the speed divided by two.So : 70 km/h ÷ 2 = 35 meters.

text: The judge is obliged to impose a revocation of the right to drive a motor vehicle for speeding in a residential area by more than …
explanation: LESSON 12If you exceed the maximum speed limit by more than 40 km/h on a motorway, a road for motor vehicles, or an ordinary road, you risk a revocation of the right to drive a motor vehicle.In addition, if you exceed the maximum speed by more than 30 km/h in a built-up area, in a 30-zone, or in a residential area, you also risk a revocation of the right to drive a motor vehicle. This is not a decision taken by the police, but by a judge in court, when your case is examined.

text: The ladder extends 1 meter in front of the car body. Is the driver allowed to drive like this?

options.text: Yes, because it is a maximum of 1 meter.
Yes, if he signals the protruding load.

explanation: LESSON 10A load may never extend beyond the front of the car body. At the rear, it may extend a maximum of 1 meter.If you need to transport a load that is longer and indivisible or cannot be collapsed or folded, it may extend up to 3 meters behind the car body, provided that you attach this warning panel to the rear of the load.

text: Past this sign you drive in a zone 30.
explanation: LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Past this sign only trailers and caravans are allowed to be parked.
explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 27

text: Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: An accident. A woman tries to remove the helmet from the motorcyclist’s head. Is this a good idea?

options.text: Yes, so he can breathe better.

explanation: LESSON 29Let an injured person lie or sit calmly.Leave the helmet on, except if the person needs to vomit, and do not give food or drinks.

text: Is the blue car allowed to drive on the lane to the right of him to change direction?
explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You are approaching this intersection and you want to turn right.

options.text: You have priority over drivers coming from the left.
You must give priority to drivers coming from the left.

explanation: LESSON 19This is not a roundabout. There are no signs regulating priority. Therefore, the priority to the right applies.

text: Was the white car allowed to overtake the blue car here?
explanation: LESSON 2The driver crossed a solid white line. That is forbidden.

text: On the motorway you must drive minimum (…) kph, in normal circumstances.
explanation: LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The driver of a car wants to overtake another car on the left. Is he allowed?
explanation: LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The black car is stopped and prevents the tram from continuing. When must the driver react?

options.text: As soon as the tram gives an audible warning.

explanation: LESSON 25You are not allowed to stop or park if you obstruct a tram.➡️ The driver must react immediately, even if the tram does not sound its bell.

text: You are driving on a motorway and there is fog. At what speed do you drive?
explanation: LESSON 4On motorways, the minimum speed is 70 km/h, but only if conditions allow it.In case of fog, snow, traffic jams, heavy rain, etc., you must of course adapt your speed.

text: You park your car on the road or on the verge during nightfall. Are you allowed to leave the dipped beam headlights on?
explanation: LESSON 11 – ‘The lights’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 19 – ‘Junction and traffic sign’. It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What should you do if you notice an oil leak under your car?

options.text: Continue driving until the next service.
Go to a garage as soon as possible.
Check the oil level before every trip and add oil if needed.

explanation: LESSON 31An oil leak can cause serious engine damage. Even if you top up the oil regularly, the leak remains dangerous. You must have the leak repaired in a garage as soon as possible.

text: Is the brown car allowed to turn left?
explanation: LESSON 24 – ‘Obligatory direction’. The brown car may turn to the right or to the left or straight on.

text: Is the car allowed to park on this priority road?
explanation: Explanation: See lesson 26

text: *** 5 points question *** On this express road in Flanders with 2x2 lanes you are allowed to drive maximum (…) kph with a car.
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 5 – ‘The express road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Can you overtake a cyclist on the right with a car on an elevated section?
explanation: For years, it has been allowed to overtake a cyclist on the right who is about to turn left. Since 2023, overtaking a cyclist on the left is also allowed.

text: Can the blue car cross the brown by the right in a built-up area?
You are in a one-way street. May you park on the left side of the roadway?

options.text: Yes, but only if the vehicle is parked in the direction of traffic.
No, parking is only allowed on the right side.

explanation: LESSON 25In a one-way street, you may park on both the left and the right side.However, the vehicle must always be parked in the direction of traffic.

text: A one-way street. The additional sign indicates that cyclists and class A mopeds may ride in the opposite direction.
explanation: The additional sign indicates that only cyclists may ride in the opposite direction.

text: Is the driver of the car at this junction allowed to overtake the moped on the left?

options.text: Yes, when there is 1 meter space between them.

explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’. It’s forbidden to overtake on the left animals in harness, a vehicle with more than 2 wheels and a two-wheeled motor vehicle on intersections where the priority from the right applies.

text: A blood test must be done by …

options.text: a designated doctor by the police.
a doctor of choice of the patient.

explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 28

text: When the verge is too small, you are allowed to park your car on a small part of the cycle lane.
explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: *** 5 points question *** Your girlfriend lives in this pedestrian zone. Can you drive your car to her home?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 7 – ‘The pedestrians’.No, that is not allowed.

text: The blue car is entering the intersection. Is the driver allowed to do that?

options.text: Yes, because he has priority from the right.
No, because the red car is going straight ahead.

explanation: LESSON 20At intersections where: there is no authorized officer, no traffic lights, and no signs regulating priority, the rule of priority to the right applies. This means that every driver (of a car, motorcycle, two-wheeled moped, or bicycle) must yield to a driver coming from the right, except when driving on a roundabout or when the driver coming from the right is coming from a prohibited direction.

text: May the truck overtake the blue car on the left?

options.text: Yes, because a truck is not a passenger car.

explanation: LESSON 16The red circular prohibition sign indicates that it is forbidden for drivers to:- overtake a combination of vehicles, or- overtake any vehicle with more than two wheels.The no-overtaking rule applies:- up to and including the next intersection, or- ends earlier if you see the “end of overtaking prohibition” sign.A car driver may therefore overtake a two-wheeled motorcycle,but the motorcyclist may not overtake a car, because a car has more than two wheels.

text: The result of a breath analysis shows 0.30mg/litre alcohol in the exhaled alveolar air. Do you get a temporary driving ban?

options.text: No, because you are below the limit.

explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 28

text: How much lateral distance must the driver keep here when overtaking the moped rider?
explanation: LESSON 15When overtaking a cyclist or a moped rider within built-up areas, you must keep 1 metre of lateral distance.Outside built-up areas, the distance must be at least 1.5 metres.

text: What is the most environmentally friendly fuel?
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 30

text: The blue car wants to leave the parking space. Who has priority?

options.text: The blue car coming from the right.

explanation: LESSON 20A driver who leaves a parking space must give way to all road users on the public road,including pedestrians.

text: This picture is taken from the car you drive. Are you still allowed to drive to the right lane?
explanation: LESSON 2 – ‘The lanes’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 21 – ‘Priority and changing directions’.The red car who wants to turn right or makes the shortest turn, has priority.The white car who wants to turn left, or makes the longest turn, has to give priority.

text: You have a provisional driving licence B. Are you allowed to drive a car on Christmas during the day?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: What kind of sign is the bottom sign?
explanation: LESSON 14 – ‘Crossing’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: How long is a Belgian driving licence in bank card format valid?
explanation: LESSON 1A Belgian driving licence in bank card format is valid for 10 years. After 10 years, you must renew it at your local municipality, without having to retake the exam.

text: You must turn right at an intersection. How should you take the turn?
explanation: LESSON 24- When turning right, you take the turn as short as possible.This prevents you from entering the part of the carriageway intended for traffic coming from the opposite direction.- When turning left, you take the turn as wide as possible.

text: How should you react in case of a fire in a tunnel?

options.text: You leave your vehicle while protecting it from theft.
You leave your vehicle and keep the key in the ignition.
You send a message to your loved ones telling them you love them.

explanation: LESSON 29You stop your vehicle as far to the right as possible, leave the key in the ignition, and exit the tunnel through the emergency exit.

text: From how many cyclists in a group are these cyclists not obliged to ride on the bicycle lane?
explanation: LESSON 3

text: Are you allowed to park your car on the yellow question mark?
explanation: Explanation: See lesson 26

text: A level crossing with barriers and lights. But the lights are out. Are you allowed to overtake a vehicle on the left?
explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Can the green car park in that parking space?
explanation: LESSON 6 - 'Special places'.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: *** 5 points question *** Who is allowed to cross the junction?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 17 – ‘Qualified persons’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Is the moped allowed to park there?
explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 27

text: A priority road outside built-up areas. On which shoulder are you allowed to park?
explanation: LESSON 26Outside built-up areas, you may park on any shoulder along a priority road, unless prohibited by traffic signs or local police. Make sure not to obstruct other traffic. Also, you may not stop or park within 5 meters of an intersection and within 20 meters of a traffic light.

text: What can the blue car do in this location?
explanation: LESSON 25On a one-way street, you can park your car on either the right or the left side

text: Can it be dangerous to always use cruise control?
explanation: LESSON 12Cruise control is a feature found in most modern vehicles. It helps promote safer and more economical driving by reducing fuel consumption.Once activated, it maintains a constant speed without the driver needing to press the accelerator.However, it does not take poor road conditions into account.In cases of snow, ice, or slippery surfaces, the car’s wheels can lose grip while cruise control continues to maintain the preset speed. This can cause loss of control or skidding, especially if the driver brakes suddenly to deactivate the system.In such conditions, experts strongly recommend not using cruise control to maintain full control of the vehicle

text: An obstacle on the cycle lane. You are not allowed to park or to be stationary within 5 meters in front or past the place where the cyclists have to use the road.
explanation: Explanation: See lesson 26

text: On a carriageway, subdivided into lanes, you approach the top of a cluttered slope. A slow bicycle is driving in front of you. Can you overtake the bike?
explanation: You may overtake near the top of a cluttered slope if the road is divided into lanes and you do not drive over the white continuous line.

text: Are you allowed to hold your mobile phone in the car while waiting at a red traffic light?
explanation: Even when stopped at a red light, you are still considered a road user and are not allowed to hold or use a mobile phone, unless it is placed in a holder designed for that purpose.

text: When the traffic lights don’t work at this junction, you must give priority.
explanation: LESSON 19 – ‘Junction and traffic sign’. It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You are approaching a roundabout here.
explanation: LESSON 19This is not a roundabout but an intersection where the priority-to-the-right rule applies.A roundabout is indicated by the blue roundabout sign and usually has either a STOP sign or a “give way” sign. Here, there is no sign at all.

text: The red car is not allowed to park in this bend. Is the driver allowed to wait to let someone out of the car?
explanation: LESSON 25 – ‘Waiting and parking’.You are not allowed to wait or park on the road in or in front of a blind corner.

text: A doctor says that you are medically unable to drive. Within how many days you have to go with your driver's license to the Town Hall?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: When the road of a motorway is segregated into at least 3 lanes, the drivers are allowed to choose the lane they want to drive in.
explanation: LESSON 4 – ‘The motorway’. It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: When you see this sign, you know the tunnel is at least (...) meters long.
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: Who has priority?
When you brake with ABS on a wet road surface, the stopping distance is the same as with ABS on a dry road surface.
explanation: LESSON 13 – ‘The stopping distance’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Must you use your indicator when you enter the motorway via the acceleration lane?

options.text: No, because you can only drive in that direction.

explanation: LESSON 4What does Article 13 of the traffic regulations say?Before carrying out a manoeuvre or a movement that requires a lateral displacement or a change of direction, the driver must indicate their intention in good time by using the direction indicators, if the vehicle is equipped with them, or otherwise, if possible, by a hand signal. This indication must stop as soon as the lateral movement or change of direction has been completed.

text: From how many people must a group of cyclists be accompanied by at least 2 supervisors?
explanation: From 51 cyclists.

text: May you overtake a slow-moving cyclist on the left in a 30 km/h zone?

options.text: Yes, if you can keep a sufficient lateral distance.

explanation: LESSON 6A 30 km/h zone is not the same as a cycle zone.Only in a cycle zone is it forbidden to overtake a cyclist.In a 30 km/h zone, you may overtake a cyclist on the left provided you keep a sufficient lateral distance.

text: This car ...

options.text: ... is allowed to turn left or right.

explanation: LESSON 24 – ‘Obligatory direction’. The blue sign says the driver must turn to the right.

text: This traffic sign warns of a danger. But to which category does this sign belong?
explanation: LESSON 1Warning signs have a triangular shape with a red border. They warn road users of a possible danger ahead.

text: Can a breath test be imposed to a pedestrian who was drunk when the accident happened, which he might have caused himself?
explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 28

text: Standing still to let someone get out is allowed....

options.text: .... only on a bus stop and on a bus lane.
.... on a bus stop, on a bus lane and on a special reserved route for buses.

explanation: LESSON 22 - 'Train - tram - bus'.Only on a bus stop.

text: May the driver of the car overtake the cyclist on the left at this intersection?

options.text: No, because it is an intersection with right-of-way from the right.
Yes, if he leaves 1.5 meters of lateral space.

explanation: LESSON 16At an intersection where right-of-way from the right applies, a cyclist may be overtaken on the left.When overtaking a cyclist (or moped) on the left, the driver must leave:1 meter of lateral distance in built-up areas.1.5 meters outside built-up areas.

text: Your car is parked. When is the rear fog light allowed to be used? A/ Only in fog. B/ Only in fog and snow. C/ In fog, snow and heavy rain.
explanation: LESSON 11 – ‘The lights’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: How much is the maximum permitted speed on an ordinary road outside the built-up area in the Brussels-Capital Region?
explanation: LESSON 10 - 'Speed'.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The M.A.W. is set by …
explanation: LESSON 9 – ‘M.A.W. and M.G.W.’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You are not allowed to park on the roadway under a bridge, but you may park on the shoulder if there is one. But are you allowed to stop on the roadway to let someone get out?
explanation: LESSON 25Both parking and waiting on the roadway under a bridge are prohibited.

text: Up to how many metres before a pedestrian crossing is it forbidden to park on the roadway?
explanation: LESSON 7It is forbidden to park or stop on a pedestrian crossing, even to let someone get in or out.It is also forbidden to park or to stop on the roadway within 5 metres before the crossing (parking on the verge is allowed if possible).The same rule applies to crossings for cyclists and two-wheeled mopeds.After the crossing, parking and stopping are allowed, unless prohibited by traffic signs.

text: The width of the seat of a passenger must be at least (…) cm.
explanation: LESSON 10 – ‘The load and the passenger spaces’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You find someone unconscious in a car. You have switched off the engine, turned on the hazard warning lights and placed the warning triangle. What should you do next?

options.text: Carefully remove the person from the vehicle.
Check the breathing and start resuscitation if necessary.

explanation: LESSON 29- First ensure your own safety and that of others.- Check the person and call 112 immediately if there is no response.- Check breathing:.. Look to see if the chest rises and falls... Listen at the mouth and nose for breathing sounds.- Is the person breathing?.. Keep the airway open (tilt the chin upwards)... Continue to monitor breathing until emergency services arrive.- Is the person not breathing or not breathing normally?..Start resuscitation immediately (chest compressions and, if possible, rescue breaths).

text: When must you take this sign into account?

options.text: Only on weekdays, 24 hours a day.
Only on weekdays, including Saturday, from 06:00 to 20:00.
Every day of the week, 24 hours a day.

explanation: LESSON 30These signs indicate the start and end of a low-emission zone (LEZ).A low-emission zone is a defined area where certain vehicles are not allowed because they emit too many harmful substances.A LEZ applies every day of the week, 24 hours a day, unless stated otherwise.Each city or municipality can decide where a LEZ is introduced.

text: This girl is 12 years old and 1.45 metres tall. She is sitting in the back seat of the car and is wearing a seat belt. Is that correct?

options.text: Yes, because she is 1.45 metres tall.
No, she must sit in a child seat because she is only 12 years old.

explanation: LESSON 10Children under 18 years old and smaller than 1.35 m must be transported in an approved child restraint system that meets the required standards.A child taller than 1.35 m may still be transported in a special child seat.Children under 18 may not be transported in the front seat in a rear-facing child seat, unless there is no front airbag or it can be deactivated.

text: There is no roundabout. Are you allowed to drive with a car in the direction of the arrow past the obstacle?
explanation: LESSON 24 – ‘Obligatory direction’. No, you have to pass the obstacle right.

text: You are not allowed to park on the road in front or past the sign of a bus stop within (…) meters.
explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What do you see on this sign?

options.text: The number of an international road.
The number of a regular road.

explanation: LESSON 4 – ‘The motorway’. It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: What is the maximum speed you are allowed to drive with studded tires on a regular road?
explanation: On a motorway: 90 kph.

text: *** 5 points question *** You have a provisional driving licence B. Are you allowed to overtake a horse in harness on the left with a car?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Which cars may be parked beyond?

options.text: Electric cars and on LPG or natural gas.

explanation: LESSON 27 – ‘Waiting and parking’.Only electric cars.

text: Heavy rainfall, but the visibility is enough. The rear fog lights ...

options.text: ... must be switched on when the spray from heavy rainfall makes it difficult to see other cars.

explanation: LESSON 11 – ‘The lights’. During heavy rain (in Belgium) they must be switched on.(In The Netherlands absolutely not).

text: When there is dense traffic on the access of a motorway …
explanation: LESSON 4 – ‘The motorway’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: In normal circumstances you are allowed to drive minimum 70 kph with a car past this sign.
explanation: Explanation: see lesson 12

text: If a police officer raises his arm, must a tram also stop?

options.text: No, because a tram always has priority.

explanation: LESSON 17When a police officer raises his arm, all drivers must stop.Drivers who are already on the intersection must leave it as quickly as possible.A tram normally has priority, but it must always obey the instructions of an authorised person and traffic lights.

text: You approach this bus stop by car and you see that the bus has its hazard warning lights on. Do you have to slow down and give way?
explanation: LESSON 22You must give way when a bus wants to leave a bus stop in a built-up area.In that case, the left indicator must be flashing, not the hazard warning lights.When the hazard warning lights are on, this simply means that the bus is stopped to allow passengers to get on or off.

text: Outside a built-up area in Wallonia. What distance must be kept between two parked cars?
explanation: LESSON 25Both inside and outside built-up areas, the required distance is 1 metre.Make sure to respect this rule during the practical driving test.

text: An arm is bleeding.

options.text: You tie off the upper arm.

explanation: Explanation: see lesson 29

text: Which traffic sign indicates this level crossing?
explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The photo is taken from the car you are driving. You want to turn right at the intersection. Are you allowed to drive here on the bus lane?
explanation: LESSON 2When approaching an intersection, you drive on the bus lane if you want to turn right.

text: *** 5 points question *** Does the driver of the blue car have to give right of way to the pedestrian?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: In a built-up area, the blue car (A) continues to drive on the left lane.

options.text: This is only permitted if the driver turns left at the next intersection.
This is not allowed, because this lane is reserved for overtaking.

explanation: It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Are you allowed to park a car on this suggested cycle lane?
explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Is this car parked correctly?
explanation: LESSON 27The blue sign indicates that vehicles must park partly on the roadway and partly on the verge.

text: The oil warning light comes on. Can you keep driving like this?

options.text: Yes, but not at high speed.
Yes, but better to go to a garage.

explanation: LESSON 31If the oil warning light goes off as soon as the engine is running, that’s fine. But if it stays on, something is wrong. Switch off the engine immediately and do not restart it, but check the oil level. If it’s too low, top up with the oil recommended in your car’s manual.

text: An accident with very minor vehicle damage at an intersection. What should you do first?

options.text: Fill in the European accident report form.

explanation: LESSON 29In the event of an accident with very minor damage, you should first move the vehicles to a safe place, if possible.This clears the intersection or roadway and helps prevent further accidents.

text: How should you wear a seat belt?
explanation: LESSON 10It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The driver of this bus has switched on the left indicator and wants to leave the bus stop, outside a built-up area. Must you give way?
explanation: LESSON 22 – Explanation:Within a built-up area, you must give way to a bus leaving a bus stop when its indicator is on.⚠️ This rule does not apply to:• coaches,• buses used for school transport or employee transport.

text: Speed can be reduced by parking reserved spaces on the road. This picture is taken within the car you drive.

options.text: The approaching traffic must give right of way to you.
You must give right of way to the approaching traffic.

explanation: LESSON 14 – ‘Crossing’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You drank beer. Your friend is sober. How will your reaction time compare to theirs?

options.text: Alcohol has no effect on reaction time.

explanation: LESSON 13Many factors can negatively affect a person’s reaction time, such as fatigue, certain medicines, or distraction. Alcohol also slows down reaction time significantly.

text: A lane closure Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: How much lateral distance should the car driver leave when he passes the cyclist.
explanation: It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: It is the 26th March. Are you allowed to park in front of these signs?
explanation: Explanation: See lesson 26

text: This car is … here.

options.text: allowed to be stationary or park.
not allowed to be stationary or park.

explanation: Explanation: See lesson 26

text: This blue sign means that in case of a road narrowing, drivers on this side of the road have priority over oncoming traffic.
explanation: LESSON 14The blue priority sign with arrows: priority.The red priority sign with arrows: give way.

text: This sign indicates a narrow passage. What kind of sign is it?
explanation: LESSON 14 – ‘Crossing’.Triangular signs with a red border are usually warning or danger signs.Warning signs stand 150 meters for a danger.

text: What is the maximum speed limit (… kph) for this car at that location in Flanders?
explanation: LESSON 12It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: This sign indicates the start of a motorway. What kind of sign is this?
explanation: LESSON 4 – ‘The motorway’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: What is correct? The direction indicator must be switched on …

options.text: ... when leaving or entering a roundabout.

explanation: LESSON 19 – ‘Junction and traffic sign’. It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The driver realizes he is driving in the wrong direction. Is he allowed to turn around here?

options.text: Yes, if he does not hinder other drivers.

explanation: LESSON 2You are not allowed to cross a solid white line — neither to turn off nor to make a U-turn.

text: Who is allowed to cross first at the junction?
explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What does this warning sign mean?

options.text: Level crossing with barriers and lights.

explanation: LESSON 22It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What is aquaplaning?

options.text: Very heavy rain causing the driver to lose visibility.
Tyres losing contact with the road surface due to a large amount of water.
Splashing water that the windscreen wipers cannot clear.

explanation: LESSON 31Aquaplaning is a phenomenon in which the tyres lose contact with the road because of a layer of water.Instead of gripping the road surface, the vehicle slides on the water.As a result, you can no longer steer, brake or accelerate normally.It can be compared to water skiing.

text: How many minutes are you allowed to park far beyond this board?
explanation: The maximum parking time can be indicated on an underboard sign.

text: You have a provisional driving licence B. Are you allowed to drive a car on a Sunday evening after 10pm?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: On the way, it rained heavily. Finally, this driver reaches the tunnel. With which lights does he continue his ride in the tunnel?

options.text: The dipped headlights and the rear fog light.
The dipped headlights, the rear fog light, and the front fog lights.

explanation: LESSON 11Inside the tunnel, it is quite dark and visibility is less than 200 meters. Therefore, you must drive with your dipped headlights on.Inside the tunnel it does not rain, so the fog lights are not used.

text: On which verge can you park within a built up area?

options.text: Only on the ground level verge.
On a ground level or elevated verge.

explanation: LESSON 25 – ‘Waiting and parking’.Outside a built up area: on a ground level or elevated verge.

text: *** 5 points question *** What is the maximum speed limit on an ordinary road in Wallonia? (... km/h)
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: This man is pushing a broken down motorcycle. What is the most complete and correct answer?

options.text: He must wear a helmet and walk on the road.
He must wear a helmet, walk on the road and have a driving licence.

explanation: LESSON 8 – ‘The drivers’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: May the blue car turn right?
explanation: LESSON 24The prohibition sign indicates that turning right is forbidden.The additional panel specifies that the prohibition applies to the street located 30 metres further on.

text: It is night. A driver is overtaking another car. May the high beams be on during the overtaking?
explanation: LESSON 11High beams must not be used:- when the road is continuously and sufficiently lit so that you can see 100 metres ahead;- when they would dazzle an oncoming road user;- when a vehicle is driving less than 50 metres ahead of you and you are not overtaking it immediately. If you are overtaking, you may use them.- when approaching a rail vehicle or a boat.

text: You are entering an intersection. Suddenly, a police officer raises his arm. What do you do?
explanation: LESSON 17When a police officer raises his arm, it means that all vehicles must stop.Vehicles already in the intersection must leave it as quickly as possible, continuing in the direction they intended to go.

text: What is indicated by this yellow line?
explanation: LESSON 2 – ‘The lanes’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: You are approaching a crossroads and you see one of these signs. At which intersection can you overtake a cyclist on the left?
explanation: It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Are you allowed to park a car on the carriageway of an expressway?
explanation: LESSON 25Stopping (being stationary) and parking are forbidden on an expressway.

text: A car, load included, is allowed to be maximum (…) meters high.
explanation: LESSON 10 – ‘The load and the passenger spaces’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: Who has priority?
explanation: LESSON 20 – ‘Priority form the right’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: The man walking next to the horse is a …
explanation: LESSON 7 – ‘The pedestrians’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Your car starts slipping. What do you do?

options.text: You pull the steering wheel shortly to the left and to the right.
You release the gas pedal and declutch.

explanation: Explanation: See lesson 31

text: On a wet road surface the braking distance is … on a dry road surface.
explanation: LESSON 13 – ‘The stopping distance’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What is the maximum permitted speed in a cycle zone in the Brussels-Capital Region?
explanation: LESSON 6A cycle zone consists of one or more public roads where cyclists (and riders of bicycles and speed pedelecs) are the main road users, while motor vehicles are also allowed.In a cycle zone, motor vehicles (including mopeds) may not overtake cyclists, speed pedelecs or bicycles up to 1 m wide.The maximum permitted speed is 30 km/h.A cycle zone ends at the “END OF ZONE” road sign.

text: Do you also have to write down the street names on the situation sketch?
explanation: LESSON 29 - 'Accident'.the road situation;. the direction of travel of the vehicles; . the position of the vehicles at the time of impact;. the road signs (lights, signs, lines);. the street names (or roads).

text: *** 5 points question *** Are you allowed to overtake a tram on the left when you come across an obstacle on the road?
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]LESSON 14 – ‘Crossing’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: An adult wants to cross the road with young children. How should you react?

options.text: You continue driving because there is no pedestrian crossing.
You stop and let the children cross calmly.
You pay extra attention and are ready to brake if a child suddenly steps onto the road.

explanation: DEFENSIVE DRIVINGChildren can behave unpredictably and may suddenly step onto the road.You adjust your speed, keep the situation under control, and are ready to brake immediately.

text: Today is 12 March. The red car has stopped to let a passenger get out. Is this allowed?
explanation: LESSON 26This traffic sign means that parking is prohibited on this side of the carriageway from the 1st to the 15th of the month.The additional plate with the black upward arrow indicates that the parking prohibition starts from the sign.➡️ Stopping (for example to allow a passenger to get in or out) is allowed.

text: Do the traffic regulations apply to a private road?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Past this sign you are allowed to drive maximum (…) km/hour with your car.
explanation: LESSON 6 – ‘Special places’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: On roads with little lighting the headlights (driving lamps) can be used instead of the dipped beam headlights if you don’t hinder anyone.
explanation: LESSON 11 – ‘The lights’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: What does this warning or danger sign mean?
explanation: LESSON 1 – ‘The public road’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Which of these signs apply to the road and to the verge?
explanation: Explanation: See lesson 26

text: What is the maximum speed at which this car may drive at that location in the Brussels Region?
explanation: LESSON 12The maximum permitted speed on an elevated section is 30 km/h throughout Belgium, regardless of the region.

text: Traffic is moving very slowly. Is this lady allowed to quickly call her employer, to say that she will arrive a bit later?
explanation: LESSON 31Electronic devices such as a phone, tablet (…) distract the driver.That is why drivers are not allowed to use, hold or manipulate a mobile electronic device with a screen while driving, unless the device is placed in a proper holder attached to the vehicle.Electronic devices may be used when the car is standing still or parked. But stopping at a traffic light or in a traffic jam is not considered as ‘standing still’.

text: You are allowed to pass this bollard to the left or to the right?
explanation: LESSON 24 – ‘Obligatory direction’. The board indicates that you should drive along the left or along the right.

text: *** 5 points question *** Past these signs in Flanders, you are allowed to drive maximum (…) kph with a car.
explanation: [Violations of the 3rd and 4th degree on our page Theory B: nr. 32]Explanation: see lesson 12.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: On a bus lane, it is forbidden to …
explanation: LESSON 22A bus lane is not a part of the roadway. Therefore, it is forbidden to drive on it, being stationary on it, or to park on it. You may only use it a few meters before an intersection to turn left or right.

text: You are driving and several passengers are in the car. Can you, as the driver, require them to wear their seat belts?
explanation: LESSON 10Everyone in the car must wear a seat belt or sit in an appropriate child seat.

text: The higher the engine speed, the more environmentally friendly you drive.
explanation: LESSON 31The higher the engine speed, the more fuel the engine consumes. This leads to higher emissions and is harmful to the environment.Environmentally friendly driving means shifting up early and keeping the engine speed as low as possible without straining the engine.

text: Are you allowed to wait 15 minutes when you have to do a breath analysis?
explanation: Explanation: See Lesson 28The 15-minute waiting period has been abolished since May 1, 2024

text: May this car stop at the bus stop to let passengers get in?
explanation: LESSON 26It is prohibited to park, but allowed to stop,up to 15 metres before and beyond a traffic sign indicating a bus, trolleybus or tram stop.➡️ Letting passengers get in or out is considered stopping, which is allowed.

text: You are driving on a priority road and you approach an intersection where a traffic officer is standing with one arm raised. What do you do?

options.text: Enter the intersection because you are on a priority road.

explanation: LESSON 17When a traffic officer raises one arm vertically, all road users must stop.Anyone already in the intersection must leave it as quickly as possible.

text: If a driver sees this sign, then he may drive ...

options.text: ... just to the right or straight ahead.
... to the left or right or straight ahead.

explanation: LESSON 24 – ‘Obligatory direction’. He may not turn to the left.

text: How tall must a child be to no longer be required to sit in an appropriate safety seat?
explanation: LESSON 10Children under the age of 18 and smaller than 1m35 must be transported in an appropriate safety seat or child restraint system that complies with the prescribed standards. (A child taller than 1m35 may still be transported in a special child seat). Children under 18 years old may not be transported in the front seat in a rear-facing child seat, unless there is no front airbag or the airbag can be deactivated.

text: One-way street. Are speedpedelecs also allowed to ride in the opposite direction?
explanation: The vehicles mentioned on the traffic sign and allowed to ride in the opposite direction are:- buses.- class A mopeds.- speedpedelecs.- bicycles.

text: Which of these signs is an information sign?
explanation: LESSON 24 – ‘Obligatory direction’. Sign 1: road with one-way traffic.Sign 2: required to follow direction of travel.

text: Within a built-up area. What distance must be kept between two parked cars?
explanation: LESSON 25Both inside and outside built-up areas, the required distance is 1 metre.

text: The dipped headlights are switched on. What is your reaction.
explanation: LESSON 17 – ‘Qualified persons’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: You are not allowed to be stationary or to park on the road within … meters of a crossing for cyclists and two-wheeled mopeds.
explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: What does the white / yellow flashing light mean in the middle of the lights for a tram?

options.text: Tram must be driven very slowly due to a possible defect on the tracks.
You may cross the light with double caution, with due observance of the prevailing priority rules.

explanation: LESSON 18 – ‘Traffic lights’.Important: double caution and compliance with the priority rules.

text: Is the driver of the red car allowed to overtake the blue one on the left?
explanation: LESSON 15 +16 – ‘Overtaking’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.

text: May the motorcycle overtake the truck on the left?
explanation: LESSON 16The red circular prohibition sign indicates that drivers are forbidden to:- overtake a combination of vehicles, or- overtake any vehicle with more than two wheels.The no-overtaking rule applies:- up to and including the next intersection, or- it ends earlier if you see the end-of-prohibition sign.A car driver may therefore overtake a two-wheeled motorcycle.But the motorcyclist may not overtake a car, because a car has more than two wheels.

text: Outside a built-up area, must you give way to a bus leaving a bus stop?
explanation: LESSON 22You must give way inside a built-up area. You must never give way to a coach leaving a bus stop.

text: Do you have to give way to drivers coming from the left here?
explanation: LESSON 19You want to enter a roundabout. The give-way sign (inverted triangle) tells you to slow down and, if necessary, stop to give way. On a roundabout, drivers can only come from the left.When entering a roundabout, you should not use the right indicator. You must, however, use it when leaving the roundabout.

text: The carriageway is narrow. May the driver of the car partly drive onto the verge in order to cross or pass the cyclist safely?
explanation: LESSON 15When overtaking or crossing / passing a cyclist outside built-up areas, a minimum lateral distance of 1,5 metres must be respected.If the carriageway is not wide enough, the driver may partly drive onto the verge to keep this distance.Within built-up areas, the required lateral distance is 1 metres.

text: Are mopeds allowed to pass this sign?

options.text: No mopeds class A or B.

explanation: LESSON 3 – ‘The bicycle lane’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time.The practice questions for the theory lessons are voiced.

text: Who is allowed to drive first under the bridge?
explanation: LESSON 14 – ‘Crossing’.It is very important to read the theory lessons if you want to pass the real exam from the first time. The practice questions for the theory lessons are with voice.
